.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of evil beings or demons, enemies of gods and men, and
 slain by Indra, (mostly Vedic in this sense).
.²2 An outcast, a Hindu who has become an outcast by neglect of the essential
 rites; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 5. 131</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">10. 45</ls>; {#dasyUnAM dIyatAmeza sADvadya puruzADamaH#}
 <ls>Mb. 12. 173. 20</ls>.
.²3 A thief, robber, bandit; {#nItvotpaTaM vizayadasyuzu nikzipanti#} <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 46</ls>;
 {#pAtrIkfto dasyurivAsi yena#} <ls>Ś. 5. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 53</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7 143</ls>.
.²4 A villain, miscreant; {#dasyorasya kfpARapAtavizayAdAcCindataH preyasIm#} <ls>Māl. 5. 28</ls>.
.²5 A desperado, violator, oppressor.
